title: gate_passed
description: Emitted by the JMT Liftoff Mod plugin each time a drone passes a RaceCheckpoint gate. Captured via a Harmony postfix on RaceCheckpoint.Trigger(); only fires when the bot is loaded into a race scene.

actor.description: Photon actor number of the drone that passed the gate

gate_time_sec.description: Unity Time.time when the gate was crossed (seconds)
